project.name: Red Hen Bakery
project.description: Site retaining wall supporting soil of varying height

codes.residential_note: Walls retaining <= 4 ft unbalanced backfill are per IRC prescriptive requirements (not engineered per this schedule)

soil._notes: Assumed typical granular backfill. Verify with project geotech report. Allowable bearing = 2500 psf assumed — confirm with geotech.

water._notes: Positive drainage assumed behind wall (gravel drain + perforated pipe + filter fabric). No hydrostatic buildup per IBC if drainage is maintained.

surcharge._notes: 100 psf equivalent fluid surcharge for adjacent grade traffic/light storage. Adjust for specific project loading.

seismic._notes: Seismic not applied in this preliminary design. Add SDC and M-O parameters when site-specific seismic data is available.

materials._notes: f'c = 3000 psi. #4 Gr.40 or smaller, #5 Gr.60 or larger. Prefer #4 and smaller. Avoid #7+.

exposure._notes: F1 moderate freeze-thaw (exterior exposed). S0 no sulfate exposure. C1 corrosion — reinforcement exposed to moisture. Cover = 2 in (cast against soil).
